legend.VCP: VCP. Long: pullbacks getting shallower under a pivot. Short: bounces getting smaller over a breakdown level
legend.FLAG: Tight flag. Long: 30%+ run then a tight flag. Short: sharp drop then a tight bear flag
legend.HTF: High tight flag: 90%+ run in 8 weeks or less, then a flag under 25% deep
legend.WBO: Weekly breakout: this week is closing through the weekly pivot on above-average volume
legend.WPV: At the weekly pivot: strong week pressing the right-side high of a weekly base, not through yet
legend.WVCP: Weekly VCP: contractions getting tighter on the weekly chart
legend.WFLAG: Weekly flag: big run, then a tight 2-10 week flag
legend.3WT: 3 weeks tight: last 3 weekly closes within 1.5%
legend.NR7: Narrowest daily range of the last 7 sessions
legend.RSBP: RS line at a new high before price. Short: RS new low before price
legend.RSNH: RS line (vs SPY) at a 52-week high. Short: 52-week low
legend.KQ: Qullamaggie momentum leader: top 7% gainer (1/3/6 mo), ADR 4%+, near highs
legend.ON: O'Neil-style leader (technical only): RS 80+, within 15% of high, 50 > 200
legend.LG: Leading group: industry in the top 20% by RS
legend.WG: Weak group: industry in the bottom 20% by RS
legend.EMA: TQE EMA stack. Long: price > 8 > 21 > 50 EMA. Short: price < 8 < 21 < 50
legend.SB4: Stockbee burst: up 4%+ today on higher volume
legend.PP: Pocket pivot: up day on volume above any down day of the last 10, above the 50 SMA
legend.DV: Down day on volume above any up day of the last 10, below the 50 SMA
legend.LQ: Liquid leader: $100M+/day and up 30%+ in 6 months
legend.OPT: Options easy to trade: 5K+ open interest, ATM spread 10% or less, weekly expirations
legend.DB: Darvas box breakout in the last 5 sessions, still above the box
legend.BD: Box breakdown in the last 5 sessions, still below the box
legend.UOA: Unusual options activity on your side (calls for longs, puts for shorts). Side of the trade unknown
legend.ER-1: Reported earnings in the last session
legend.TRG: Triggered today: price crossed the pivot / trigger during the session
legend.ER+: Earnings within 7 days: size down or wait
legend.EXT: Extended: 7+ ADRs from the 50 SMA, wait for a pullback
legend.THIN: Options hard to trade: little open interest or wide spreads
legend.SEC: Sector rotation is with you: Leading/Improving for longs, Lagging/Weakening for shorts
legend.THEME: 3+ setups in this industry tonight: a group move, not a lone name
